files.note: General-settings collapser: real rows are the slot wrapper children, not the wrapper itself (the whole page used to be hidden as a single "advanced" row).

Drops the 价格设置 settings section and its now-unreachable implementation: its balancePrices/balanceModels/refreshBalance bridge is retired by ADR 0006, so the section could only ever render a misleading "桥接不可用" error. The composer dock is unchanged.

Update-notice button contrast: pin light values (outline 1.10:1 -> 3.11:1, label 1.06:1 -> 4.95:1) on the dark glass card. Regenerated for 1.3.3 (anchor line moved 4795 -> 4721; upstream still ships align-self: flex-end unchanged).

Settings panel gained a second, page-level scrollbar on the Skins section. Cause: the visually-hidden import file input (.orL4ja_fileInput) is position:absolute with no left/top and its container .orL4ja_backupActions is not positioned, so its containing block resolves all the way up to the settings dialog (JPxlLa_panel, position:relative, overflow:auto). The 1px input then lands below the panel and inflates the panel scrollHeight by 104px; scrolling the panel drags the whole nav rail out of view. Fix: give .orL4ja_backupActions position:relative so the input is contained by its own button row. Verified by three independent probes (hiding the input / adding relative to the options scroller / adding relative to the parent all drop the panel overflow 104px -> 0), and the hidden input still fires clicks so import keeps working. 另修：皮肤卡片高度参差 —— .orL4ja_skinTile 的 versionRow 可换行导致同一行卡片底部错位（112/134/114.5px 三种），视觉上互相压边。统一 tile min-height:132px 并让 versionRow 不换行+省略；实测 12 个 tile 高度全部一致、零裁字。

patches.name: computer-user

files.note: Export the settings schema AND keep it on the default export. On a 0.2.x kernel SettingsForms.schema(entry) reads entry.fiber.runtime.Config (the namespace-registration model was retired and replaced by schema-derived configForms forms). Two separate gates then apply, and a named export alone fails the first: cordis-plugin-loader unwrapExports() collapses the module to its default export before cordis reads plugin.Config (xports = exports.default ?? exports), so with both a named Config and a default object the schema is discarded and describe() omits the namespace. Adding Config to the default object is what actually restores the form; the named binding is kept for tooling.

Mark every Config field volatile(). volatileForm() keeps only fields under a volatile ancestor, so the unmarked upstream schema still projects to undefined and no form is produced even once Config is exported. The live() helper degrades to the plain schema when a schemastery build has no volatile().

Drop the retired settingsScope inject and probe both transport generations instead. Declaring a service no kernel provides parks the client fiber forever in waitingFor, so the whole card vanishes with no error. Now: configForms.get(entryId) on 0.2.x (ConfigFormController already carries the same getSnapshot/subscribe/set/unset surface the Section component uses), settingsScope.bind() on 0.1.x, and no section registered at all when neither exists. Upstream 0.3.7 targets the 0.1.3 kernel, so its browser half still carries this 0.1.x-only inject; this patch supplies the 0.2.x adaptation locally and can be dropped once upstream ships a 0.2.x-compatible client.

patches.summary: Expose Config on the default export (the loader unwraps to default, so a named export alone is dropped), mark its fields volatile, and swap the retired settingsScope inject for a dual-generation configForms probe. Upstream 0.3.7 is maintained but targets the 0.1.3 kernel; drop these patches once it ships a 0.2.x release.

patches.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-openclaw-bridge
patches.summary: openclaw-bridge: settingsNamespace/installSettingsSection 具名导出与 settingsScope 服务在 0.2.x 均退役，且设置表单改由 Config schema 派生。本补丁补齐三处；桥接路由与微信区块不受影响。

files.note: Host side stops importing the retired settingsNamespace/installSettingsSection (link-time SyntaxError takes down the whole plugin tree including the bridge routes) and marks the schema volatile() so 0.2.x derives a settings form at all.
Client fiber no longer injects the retired settingsScope service (permanent waitingFor). Runtime probe prefers configForms (0.2.x) and falls back to settingsScope (0.1.x).

Self-contained 0.1.x-compatible shim for the retired @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings userland (settingsNamespace / installSettingsSection) plus a createSettingsScope helper that rebuilds the retired ctx.settings.register() surface on top of the 0.2.x describe()/update() API. EAC plugins ship self-contained and do not resolve through the kernel package graph, so this file travels with the plugin.

patches.name: dsh-session-manager
patches.summary: session-manager 的客户端引用了 primitives 的两个图标旧名 IconArchiveOutline20 / IconWarningOutline16；0.2.x 已改名为去后缀的 IconArchiveOutline / IconWarningOutline（尺寸由 size prop 控制，本就传了）。不改则 h(undefined) → React #130，sidebar.footer.action 槽位整个消失。

files.note: The client referenced two primitives icons by their old size-suffixed names (IconArchiveOutline20, IconWarningOutline16). 0.2.x renamed them to IconArchiveOutline / IconWarningOutline and drives size via the size prop (already passed). With the old names P.<icon> is undefined, so h(undefined) throws React #130 and the whole sidebar.footer.action seat disappears.

patches.name: dsh-webui-prompt-optimizer
patches.summary: Two client fixes: primitives icon names updated to the 0.2.x <Name>Medium variants (old names were undefined → React #130), and an unguarded modelDirectories.directoryFor() call during early boot no longer throws "remote.session without inject" and blanks the input row.

files.note: Two fixes. (1) The client referenced two primitives icons by old size-suffixed names (IconLoadingOutline16 / IconSparkle16); 0.2.x exports only <Name>Regular / <Name>Medium, so those lookups are undefined and jsx(undefined) throws React #130, crashing the conversation.input.right seat. (2) The seat"s inject called modelDirectories.directoryFor() unguarded; during early boot the remote.session namespace is not mounted yet, so it throws "cannot get property "remote.session" without inject" (measured once, ~2.2s after navigation, never again) and takes down the whole input row for that frame. Now caught and degraded to available:false with an inert placeholder store, because the component subscribes to directory before its available:false early-return.

patches.name: @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams
patches.summary: agent-teams 在 0.2.x 上因 ctx.subagents.registerContinuableSetup 被退役（改 provider 模式）而在 apply 期抛 TypeError，整个插件不激活、8 个 agent_teams_* 工具全丢。本补丁改为存在性探测 + 降级：缺该钩子时成员模型选择的持久化/冷恢复降级，建队/任务 DAG/派活/消息/状态照常可用。

files.note: 0.2.x SubagentRuntime retired registerContinuableSetup (replaced by the provider model: registerProvider + observeActivation). Calling it unconditionally threw during apply(), so the fiber failed and none of the 8 agent_teams_* tools registered. Detect its absence and degrade that one enhancement (member model-route persistence on cold resume) while team creation, task DAG, dispatch, messaging and status keep working.

Old size-suffixed primitives icon names (…16 / …14) were removed in 0.2.x, which exports only <Name>Medium / <Name>Regular. As written, jsx(undefined) throws React #130 and this surface renders as an empty div.

files.note: .mkts-chip-on / .mkts-sort button.on / .mkts-cmdbtn-primary / .mkts-avatar 的 color 由 bg-layer-3（浅色背景变量）改为 label-primary-foreground；.mkts-cmdbtn-primary:hover 同步修正并把 opacity 由 .85 提到 .9。bg-layer-3 作为 background 的用法（.mkts-item 等）正确，未改动。注意：该包不在 profile package.json 依赖内，由市场运行时自行落盘到 node_modules，此补丁只覆盖重打包产物。
